title: White-glove experiment rollout canvas and 24hr watch slate
content:
Purpose and scope:
This document is a compact white-glove checklist + micro-calendar for an experimental feature roll (feature flag gating) that needs high-touch monitoring for the first 24 hours. Unlike normal bulk rollouts, this run is intentionally small cohorts (1% -> 5% -> 15%) with manual gates at each step and strict latency/cost/quality guardrails. Use this for experiments that touch inference routing, fallback behavior, or anything that could affect tail latency.

Primary contacts:
- Owner: Aisha Patel (release eng)
- On-call SRE: Liam Chen
- Product lead (experiment): Rosa Martinez
- Model infra (serving): Ethan Walker
- Observability SME: N. Alvarez (pager)

Preflight (T-72 to T-2 hours) — checklist (tick before move to T-0):
[ ] Feature flag created in FF system (flag id: ff/experiment/2026-06-whiteglove)
[ ] PR merged and pinned revision: rw-runtime@c9f2b3 (link in linked_artifacts)
[ ] Canary image pushed to registries and digest verified
[ ] Load test smoke: 30m long synthetic run matching baseline p95, p99 targets (attach logs)
[ ] Baseline telemetry snapshot saved (token cost/day, avg latency, error rate)
[ ] Rollback playbook validated against this change (doc ref PROD-3321)
[ ] Pager rotation scheduled for 24h watch; two-person handoffs mapped
[ ] Stakeholder readout calendar invite sent: #release-orchestra, invite includes product, SRE, runtime
[ ] Client-facing rollback checklist drafted (support template in linked_artifacts)

Risk matrix (quick):
- Regression in p99 latency: HIGH — rollback immediate if 2x baseline or >500ms absolute increase
- Increased per-token cost on new route: MEDIUM — manual throttling if cost delta > 10% sustained for >30m
- Model score drift / quality regression: HIGH — pause cohort growth and trigger evaluation harness
- Sparse errors (auth, 5xx): LOW-MED — escalate if >1% error rate sustained for 15m

Guardrail metrics and thresholds (automated triggers + manual gates):
- p50/p95/p99 latency: watch p99 specifically; automated alert if +30% vs baseline or +250ms
- Error rate (5xx + runtime errors): alert if >0.5% sustained for 10m; page at >1% for 5m
- Cost per 1k tokens: alert if >10% increase for 30m
- Successful response ratio (>= 200 OK + schema match): <98% pause growth
- QA synthetic eval score: fail if top-level metric drops >5 points compared to baseline evaluation set

24hr rollout calendar (micro-slate) — all times UTC, day = D
T-24h: final preflight check and stakeholder signoff (owner + product + SRE)
T-2h: canary cluster readiness check, traffic routing rehearsed, double-check feature flag targeting rules
T-0h (Start): Enable flag for cohort A = 1% (subset: internal dry-run + trusted beta users). Start 2h watch block.
T+2h: Gate 1 decision (manual) — move to 5% if metrics healthy for last 60m; else rollback to 0% or keep at 1% and extend watch
T+6h: If at 5% and stable for 3h, product + SRE signoff to go to 15%
T+12h: If at 15% and no guardrail trips, open to broader 50% auto-rollover for next week (hand off to product ops).
T+24h: Post-mortem and short retro; keep flag for quick rollback for 7 days.

Decision criteria template (what to check at each gate):
- Latency: p99 within thresholds for last 60m
- Errors: no sustained increase above alert thresholds
- Cost: rolling 30m cost delta acceptable
- Quality: sample audit of 40 responses from live traffic evaluated by product (quick judgement)
- External signals: no active customer tickets mentioning regressions
Decision outcomes: "proceed", "hold-and-extend-watch (specify duration)", "rollback". Call out decision in #release-orchestra with short rationale.

Rollback matrix (fastest path):
1) Flip feature flag to 0% (global) — immediate effect on control plane.
2) If flag flip fails or degraded control plane detected: roll runtime route to baseline model revision (rw-runtime@b8a1f0) via emergency routing job (ops-only).
3) If routing job fails: scale down new serving pool and replace with golden pool (SRE assisted).
4) Post-reversion tasks: run regression smoke tests, capture traces/heap, collect traces for 60m, open incident ticket for RCA.

Communication templates (Slack + cadence):
- Gate message (example): "[GATE] D+2h: Cohort A=1% -> Decision window: metrics stable. Recommend proceed to 5% — approvers: Aisha, Liam, Rosa. Reply with +1 to approve or :pause: to hold."
- Rollback broadcast: "[ROLLBACK] Rolling back ff/experiment/2026-06-whiteglove to 0% due to p99 latency breach. Owner: Aisha. Incident ticket: PROD-3321. Follow up: 1h post-rollback telecon."
- Post-mortem stub: include timeline, decision points, signals triggered, and lessons.

Watch rotation and handoff notes (practical):
- 0-6h: Owner + On-call SRE (Aisha + Liam)
- 6-12h: On-call SRE + Observability SME (Liam + N. Alvarez)
- 12-24h: Product ops + SRE (Rosa + backup SRE)
Handoffs: 15m overlap, status message in #release-orchestra with snapshots attached (short link to telemetry dashboard).

Lightweight smoke checklist to run manually whenever you feel the metrics look off:
- Pull top-100 requests and re-run against staging model to compare latencies and outputs
- Check CPU/GPU utilization on serving nodes (if >85% sustained, consider throttling)
- Validate cache hit ratio for KV cache (expected baseline >78%)
- Check model shard distribution and any rebalancing events in the last 2h

Post-release (within 48h) — deliverables:
- Short release note (public internal) with: what changed, cohorts, timeline, immediate action taken (if any), and link to post-mortem
- RCA if any guardrails tripped (owner pinned)
- Close experiment flag if success and plan to roll to broader audience OR schedule sunset if experiment fails

Draft internal release note (copy to use in announcements):
Title: "White-glove flag rollout: experiment ff/experiment/2026-06-whiteglove"
Summary: "On D we enabled a staged experiment for routing behavior to test fallback selector changes. We rolled cohorts 1% -> 5% -> 15% under white-glove watch; no major regressions observed. See telemetry snapshots and QA samples attached. Flag remains enabled at 15% pending product ops runway."
Impact: "Minor: small p50 shift during first hour, p99 unchanged after 2h; no customer-facing errors logged."
Follow-ups: "Rosa to coordinate next expansion plan. Aisha to author RCA if we see delayed issues."

Notes, open questions and TODOs (owner responsibilities):
- TODO: finalize synthetic eval bundle and pin to run automatically at each gate (owner: Ethan)
- TODO: add cost-emergency runbook steps into 1-click console (owner: Platform Eng)
- Question: should we auto-throttle new cohort growth on cost delta alone? Recommend manual for now.

Appendix: quick links and snippets
- Slack channel: #release-orchestra
- Pager duty escalation: SRE-team-oncall
- Small query to snapshot p99: (Grafana quick link in linked_artifacts)

End of slate. This doc is intentionally terse and operational — keep it next to the PR and experiment page, and copy into any ad-hoc runbooks for similar experiments.
